summary: Proved two bounded WEIGHTS014 candidates pending distinct review: exact prime-relative means and actual-prime first/mixed moments from finite positive Taylor errors and inspected prime BV, followed by fixed-number variance and successive-limit removal; and reflected prime Mobius cancellation on each fixed small-radical class using the actual accepted 008-013 revisions. claims.text: The exact local probabilities 1/(r-1), finite divisor expansions with positive arithmetic remainders, endpoint prime BV and bounded diagonal yield the stated first/mixed prime moments and variance with leading constant independent of the fixed number b.
Taking H to infinity for each fixed b and then b to infinity removes the auxiliary weights against any bounded target whose normalized marked correlations vanish for every fixed construction.

Relative to the actual accepted 008-013 written dependencies and their named classical inputs, every fixed small-radical class rad(H)<=log^C H of even shifts satisfies sum_(p<H)mu(H-p)log p=o(H) and sum_(p<H)mu(H-p)=o(pi(H)); the general even-H version requires the explicit fixed-b family of selected-strip hypotheses.

The assertions that integer/root local means may replace prime-relative means, disjointness may be omitted, or fixed-b errors automatically give a growing-b rate are refuted by the displayed finite population and counterarray examples.
A classical general-H selected-strip family, a growing-b rate, source-wide Guo/LWW validation, novelty, a polynomial-rough prime-boundary lower margin and Goldbach remain unestablished.
